title: 2007, Feb 23 last day school staff waving to last bus
description: Before the doors closed for the final time on February 24, 2007, a last, bittersweet picture was taken of the gym—a place that had witnessed so many chapters of our lives. Though the lights are dim and the doors are shut, the gym will never truly sleep. Its walls are alive with memories, quietly listening to the echoes of the past. If you listen closely, you can almost hear the cheers that once rattled the rafters, the squeak of sneakers racing across the floor, and the breathless excitement of games won and lost. You can feel the nervous tension before a big performance, the laughter shared between friends, and the playful banter before each contest. Every corner holds the memory of hard-fought victories, comforting hugs after tough losses, and the unbreakable bonds forged through teamwork. Even now, the old gym remembers it all—the thump of a basketball, the band's music, the stomp of feet on the bleachers, the clang of water bottles, the nervous giggles and anxious whispers. Though time moves on, the spirit of those moments lingers, making the gym a silent guardian of dreams, friendships, and memories that will never fade.
